newsitem.title: CHINA: China replaces ambassador to North Korea.
newsitem.headline: China replaces ambassador to North Korea.

text.p: China's ambassador to North Korea has returned to Beijing after finishing his term of duty, Chinese officials said on Wednesday.
China's envoy to Pyongyang Qiao Zonghuai returned home on March 11 and would be replaced by Wan Yongxiang, an official of the Chinese Foreign Ministry said.
It was not yet known when Wan, a former assistant to Foreign Minister Qian Qichen, would go to Pyongyang to take up his new post, the official said.
Wan's appointment still needed the approval of parliament and state President Jiang Zemin, another official said.
Qiao's return was not connected to a diplomatic crisis involving the most senior North Korean official to defect to South Korea, he said.
Hwang Jang-yop, a top aide to North Korea's supreme leader Kim Jong-il, has been holed up in Seoul's consular compound in Beijing since February 12 while the three nations negotiate his fate.
